Pretty much the title, but specifically, I refer to the phenomenon of looking at a watch or clock in a dream, and the numbers are never right, from 55:72 to 3-.{+ I've seen in my dreams, and if you check again, the reading will be completely different.
Why can't you read time while dreaming?

Time doesnt really exist to the unconscious mind, at least not in the same way. Time is an attribute of reality, your dreams have no use for it. Thus your mind makes up whatever it needs to in order to keep your dream going. Hell, most things in dreams don't make sense, Time is just another one of those thing
that is not the question though, he asked why the digits don't make sense as they never do regardless if it is time or any other setting like dates, numbers or even writing.
They dont make sense because they dont NEED to make sense for the dream to continue.

Interesting... I mean that does make sense in a weird way.

Take for example, going from one place to another in a dream:

You rarely have any real memory of the journey, you might know you went by car, or plane, but you won't remember the drive or flight. You don't NEED the journey to dream a new setting, so your brain just ad-libs.

Exactly. Your brain already knows the outline of the story before it happens, it just fills in the details with nonsense and hopes you dont notice. For instance, when was the last time you paid attention to your shoes in your dreams.

Only if they were important to the story. Clothes too. But it's an interesting point, and I think the main reason this all happens:

Your brain already knows the outline of the story before it happens, it just fills in the details
